tenses.sentence: 'I'm working from home today,' she said. → She said she ___ from home that day.
tenses.explanation: Present continuous → past continuous; today → that day.

tenses.sentence: 'We've finished the project,' they said. → They said they ___ the project.
tenses.explanation: Present perfect → past perfect.

tenses.sentence: 'I saw the film last week,' Tom said. → Tom said he ___ the film the week before.
tenses.explanation: Past simple → past perfect; last week → the week before / the previous week.

tenses.sentence: 'I'll call you tomorrow,' he said. → He said he ___ me the next day.
tenses.explanation: will → would; tomorrow → the next / following day.

tenses.sentence: 'You may need a coat,' Mum said. → Mum said I ___ need a coat.
tenses.explanation: may → might.

tenses.sentence: 'You must wear a helmet,' the instructor said. → The instructor said we ___ wear a helmet.
tenses.explanation: must (obligación) → had to (o must).

tenses.sentence: 'I'd never been abroad before,' she said. → She said she ___ abroad before.
tenses.explanation: Past perfect no cambia: no puede ir más atrás.

tenses.sentence: 'You should rest,' the doctor said. → The doctor said I ___ rest.
tenses.explanation: Should no cambia.

tenses.sentence: 'If it rains, we'll stay at home,' they said. → They said that if it rained, they ___ at home.
tenses.explanation: 1st conditional → 2nd conditional.

tenses.sentence: 'Water boils at 100°C,' the teacher said. → The teacher said water ___ at 100°C.
tenses.explanation: Sigue siendo verdad (hecho científico): no hace falta cambiar el tiempo.

tenses.sentence: Mark (on the phone, now): 'I'm stuck in traffic.' → Mark says he ___ stuck in traffic.
tenses.explanation: El verbo introductorio está en presente (says): el tiempo no cambia.

tenses.sentence: 'I came here ten minutes ago,' he said. → He said he had come there ten minutes ___.
tenses.explanation: ago → before / earlier.

tenses.sentence: 'I bought these shoes here,' she said. → She said she had bought ___ shoes ___.
tenses.explanation: these → those; here → there.

tenses.sentence: He ___ me that he had lost his keys.
tenses.explanation: Tell + persona (told me). Say no lleva persona directamente (said that... / said to me...).

tenses.sentence: 'I've been waiting for an hour,' she said. → She said she ___ ___ waiting for an hour. (2 words)
tenses.explanation: Present perfect continuous → past perfect continuous.

tenses.sentence: 'I can't come to the party,' Ana said. → Ana said she ___ come to the party.
tenses.explanation: can → could.

tenses.sentence: 'I was sleeping when you phoned,' he said. → He said he ___ ___ sleeping when I had phoned. (2 words)
tenses.explanation: Past continuous → past perfect continuous.

tenses.sentence: 'I'll see you next week,' she said. → She said she would see me the ___ week.
tenses.explanation: next week → the following week (o the week after).

tenses.sentence: 'We met yesterday,' they said. → They said they had met the ___ day.
tenses.explanation: yesterday → the previous day / the day before.

tenses.sentence: 'I love you,' Dan said to me. → Dan said ___ loved me.
tenses.explanation: Los pronombres cambian según quién cuenta: I → he.

questions.sentence: 'Where do you live?' she asked. → She asked me where ___.
questions.explanation: Orden afirmativo (sujeto + verbo), sin do / did.

questions.sentence: 'Are you coming tonight?' he asked. → He asked me ___ I was coming that night.
'What time does the train leave?' the tourist asked. → The tourist asked what time ___.
questions.explanation: Sin does: sujeto + verbo en pasado.

questions.sentence: 'Have you ever been to Paris?' she asked. → She asked me ___ been to Paris.
questions.explanation: whether + sujeto + verbo; present perfect → past perfect.

questions.sentence: 'Don't touch the wire!' the electrician said. → The electrician told me ___ the wire.
questions.explanation: Orden negativa: tell + objeto + NOT TO + infinitivo.

questions.sentence: 'Please sit down,' the nurse said to us. → The nurse asked ___ down.
'How long have you been learning English?' she asked. → She asked me how long ___ English.
questions.explanation: Orden afirmativo + present perfect continuous → past perfect continuous.

questions.sentence: 'Can you help me?' he asked. → He asked ___ help him.
'Did you see the news?' she asked. → She asked me ___ I had seen the news.
'Why are you crying?' he asked. → He asked me why I ___ crying.
questions.explanation: Orden afirmativo: I was crying (no 'was I').

questions.sentence: 'Who did you meet?' she asked. → She asked me who I ___ ___. (2 words)
questions.explanation: Sin did; past simple → past perfect.

questions.sentence: 'Wait outside!' Mum told the children. → Mum ordered the children ___ ___ outside. (2 words)
'Don't be late,' she told him. → She told him ___ ___ ___ late. (3 words)

questions.lead_in: 'Where did you put the keys?' my mother asked me.
questions.explanation: Wh- + sujeto + verbo; past simple → past perfect.

questions.lead_in: 'Will you help me with this box?' she asked him.
questions.explanation: Yes / No → whether; will → would; this → that.

questions.lead_in: 'Please repeat the question,' she said to the reporter.
